intent:
This repo is a small static site: one page, index.html, no build step.

Add three things:

1. `about.html` — a short paragraph saying what this repo is, taken from README.md.
2. `files.html` — a list of the repo's markdown files, one line each saying what it holds.
3. A nav in `index.html` linking to both new pages. This one needs the first two to exist.

Use your orchestration skill for this. Write the plan as a task list and ask me to approve it. Give every task a `Files:` line and a `Check:` line that really checks it — there is no build step, so a `grep -q` on the file is a fine check — and give the plan a project check of its own. Then run as subagents the tasks that qualify, and land each one's work on your branch.

Publish nothing: no push, no pull request. Match the style of index.html.
title: Static site about-and-file-index pages
